description: Call-center staffing calculator (Erlang C) — How many agents a contact center, support queue or chat desk needs. calls= contacts arriving per interval and aht= average handle time in seconds (required). Optional: interval= minutes (default 30), sla= target percent answered (default 80), answer_time= seconds (default 20), shrinkage= percent (default 30), max_occupancy= percent (default 85), agents= to check your current staffing. Returns traffic in Erlangs, required and scheduled agents, service level, probability of waiting, average speed of answer, occupancy, the binding constraint and a staffing table around the answer. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
